quote: Love shook my heart like a wind falling on oaks on a mountain.
author: Sappho

quote: When I look at you, even a moment, no speaking is left in me; my tongue breaks, and thin fire is racing under my skin.
author: Sappho

quote: Love is born into every human being; it calls back the halves of our original nature together; it tries to make one out of two and heal the wound of human nature.
author: Plato

quote: Set me as a seal upon your heart, as a seal upon your arm; for love is strong as death, jealousy is fierce as the grave.
author: Song of Songs (Hebrew Bible)

quote: My beloved is mine, and I am his.
author: Song of Songs (Hebrew Bible)

quote: I hate and I love. Why I do this, perhaps you ask. I know not, but I feel it happening and I am tortured.
author: Catullus

quote: Let us live, my Lesbia, and let us love, and value at a penny all the talk of crabbed old men.
author: Catullus

quote: Love conquers all; let us too yield to Love.
author: Virgil

quote: Every lover is a soldier, and Cupid has his own camp.
author: Ovid

quote: Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud.
author: Paul the Apostle

quote: In heaven, we would be two birds flying together; on earth, two trees with branches intertwined.
author: Bai Juyi

quote: This night of no moon there is no way to meet him. I rise in longing—my breast pounds, a leaping flame, my heart is consumed in fire.
author: Ono no Komachi

quote: Although I come to you constantly over the roads of dreams, those nights are not counted as times of meeting.
author: Ono no Komachi

quote: I used my longing for him as a pillow—then that disappeared too, and all I had left was the night.
author: Izumi Shikibu
source: The Ink Dark Moon, trans. Jane Hirshfield

quote: The minute I heard my first love story, I started looking for you, not knowing how blind that was. Lovers don't finally meet somewhere. They're in each other all along.
author: Jalal al-Din Rumi (trans. Coleman Barks)

quote: Let yourself be silently drawn by the strange pull of what you really love. It will not lead you astray.
author: Jalal al-Din Rumi (trans. Coleman Barks)

quote: In that book which is my memory, on the first page of the chapter that is the day when I first met you, appear the words, 'Here begins a new life.'
author: Dante Alighieri

quote: Love, that exempts no one beloved from loving, seized me so strongly with his charm that, as you see, it does not leave me yet.
author: Dante Alighieri

quote: There is no greater sorrow than to recall happiness in times of misery.
author: Dante Alighieri

quote: Blessed be the day, and the month, and the year, and the season, and the time, and the hour, and the instant, and the place where I was struck by two lovely eyes.
author: Petrarch

quote: Love is a fire that burns unseen, a wound that aches yet isn't felt, an always discontent contentment, a pain that rages without hurting.
author: Luís de Camões

quote: Who ever loved, that loved not at first sight?
author: Christopher Marlowe

quote: Did my heart love till now? Forswear it, sight! For I ne'er saw true beauty till this night.
author: William Shakespeare

quote: My bounty is as boundless as the sea, my love as deep; the more I give to thee, the more I have, for both are infinite.
author: William Shakespeare

quote: Good night, good night! Parting is such sweet sorrow, that I shall say good night till it be morrow.
author: William Shakespeare

quote: Love sought is good, but given unsought is better.
author: William Shakespeare

quote: Shall I compare thee to a summer's day? Thou art more lovely and more temperate.
author: William Shakespeare

quote: Love is not love which alters when it alteration finds, or bends with the remover to remove.
author: William Shakespeare

quote: My love is as a fever, longing still for that which longer nurseth the disease.
author: William Shakespeare

quote: I wonder, by my troth, what thou and I did, till we loved? Were we not weaned till then?
author: John Donne

quote: Thy firmness makes my circle just, and makes me end where I begun.
author: John Donne

quote: She is all states, and all princes I; nothing else is.
author: John Donne

quote: With thee conversing I forget all time, all seasons, and their change; all please alike.
author: John Milton

quote: Had we but world enough and time, this coyness, lady, were no crime.
author: Andrew Marvell

quote: I have so much in me, and the feeling for her absorbs it all; I have so much, and without her it all comes to nothing.
author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quote: O, my Luve is like a red, red rose that's newly sprung in June.
author: Robert Burns

quote: She walks in beauty, like the night of cloudless climes and starry skies.
author: Lord Byron

quote: All things by a law divine in one another's being mingle—why not I with thine?
author: Percy Bysshe Shelley

quote: Bright star, would I were steadfast as thou art—not in lone splendour hung aloft the night.
author: John Keats

quote: I cannot exist without you. I am forgetful of everything but seeing you again.
author: John Keats

quote: In vain I have struggled. It will not do. My feelings will not be repressed. You must allow me to tell you how ardently I admire and love you.
author: Jane Austen

quote: If I loved you less, I might be able to talk about it more.
author: Jane Austen

quote: You pierce my soul. I am half agony, half hope. Tell me not that I am too late, that such precious feelings are gone for ever.
author: Jane Austen

quote: I have loved none but you. Unjust I may have been, weak and resentful I have been, but never inconstant.
author: Jane Austen

quote: I loved you; even now I may confess, some embers of my love their fire retain.
author: Alexander Pushkin

quote: Whatever our souls are made of, his and mine are the same.
author: Emily Brontë

quote: I love the ground under his feet, and the air over his head, and everything he touches and every word he says.
author: Emily Brontë

quote: I have for the first time found what I can truly love—I have found you. You are my sympathy—my better self—my good angel.
author: Charlotte Brontë

quote: Every atom of your flesh is as dear to me as my own: in pain and sickness it would still be dear.
author: Charlotte Brontë

quote: We loved with a love that was more than love.
author: Edgar Allan Poe

quote: How do I love thee? Let me count the ways. I love thee to the depth and breadth and height my soul can reach.
author: Elizabeth Barrett Browning

quote: I love thee with the breath, smiles, tears, of all my life; and, if God choose, I shall but love thee better after death.
author: Elizabeth Barrett Browning

quote: If thou must love me, let it be for nought except for love's sake only.
author: Elizabeth Barrett Browning

quote: 'Tis better to have loved and lost than never to have loved at all.
author: Alfred, Lord Tennyson

quote: I wish you to know that you have been the last dream of my soul.
author: Charles Dickens

quote: A Book of Verses underneath the Bough, a Jug of Wine, a Loaf of Bread—and Thou beside me singing in the Wilderness—oh, Wilderness were Paradise enow!
author: Omar Khayyam (trans. Edward FitzGerald)

quote: What greater thing is there for two human souls, than to feel that they are joined for life?
author: George Eliot

quote: I loved her against reason, against promise, against peace, against hope, against happiness, against all discouragement that could be.
author: Charles Dickens

quote: The heart wants what it wants—or else it does not care.
author: Emily Dickinson

quote: I cannot live with You—It would be Life—and Life is over there—behind the Shelf.
author: Emily Dickinson

quote: Remember me when I am gone away, gone far away into the silent land.
author: Christina Rossetti

quote: Come to me in the silence of the night; come in the speaking silence of a dream.
author: Christina Rossetti

quote: Grow old along with me! The best is yet to be.
author: Robert Browning

quote: That Love is all there is, is all we know of Love.
author: Emily Dickinson

quote: Explain my preference! I never had a preference for her, any more than I have a preference for breathing.
author: George Eliot

quote: Her love was entire as a child's, and though warm as summer it was fresh as spring.
author: Thomas Hardy

quote: He stepped down, trying not to look long at her, as if she were the sun, yet he saw her, like the sun, even without looking.
author: Leo Tolstoy

quote: When you are old and grey and full of sleep, and nodding by the fire, take down this book, and slowly read, and dream of the soft look your eyes had once.
author: W. B. Yeats

quote: My own one, I have never loved anyone in the world but you.
author: Oscar Wilde

quote: I have spread my dreams under your feet; tread softly because you tread on my dreams.
author: W. B. Yeats
source: He Wishes for the Cloths of Heaven

quote: For one human being to love another: that is perhaps the most difficult of all our tasks, the ultimate, the last test and proof, the work for which all other work is but preparation.
author: Rainer Maria Rilke

quote: I seem to have loved you in numberless forms, numberless times, in life after life, in age after age, forever.
author: Rabindranath Tagore

quote: Time does not bring relief; you all have lied who told me time would ease me of my pain.
author: Edna St. Vincent Millay

quote: When love beckons to you, follow him, though his ways are hard and steep.
author: Kahlil Gibran

quote: Love possesses not, nor would it be possessed; for love is sufficient unto love.
author: Kahlil Gibran

quote: What lips my lips have kissed, and where, and why, I have forgotten, and what arms have lain under my head till morning.
author: Edna St. Vincent Millay
source: What lips my lips have kissed, and where, and why

quote: I can write the saddest lines tonight. Love is so short, forgetting is so long.
author: Pablo Neruda
source: Twenty Love Poems and a Song of Despair

quote: He knew that when he kissed this girl, and forever wed his unutterable visions to her perishable breath, his mind would never romp again like the mind of God.
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald

quote: Why, darling, I don't live at all when I'm not with you.
author: Ernest Hemingway

quote: i carry your heart with me(i carry it in my heart)
author: E. E. Cummings
source: i carry your heart with me

quote: I sinned a sin full of pleasure, in an embrace that was warm and fiery.
author: Forough Farrokhzad

quote: If you cannot love me, I will die. Before you came I wanted to die. It is cruel to have made me want to live only to make my death more bloody.
author: James Baldwin

quote: Because two bodies, naked and entwined, leap over time, they are invulnerable.
author: Octavio Paz

quote: I love you without knowing how, or when, or from where. I love you simply, without problems or pride.
author: Pablo Neruda

quote: I love you as certain dark things are to be loved, in secret, between the shadow and the soul.
author: Pablo Neruda

quote: You will hear thunder and remember me, and think: she wanted storms.
author: Anna Akhmatova

quote: I have studied the tight curls on the back of your neck moving away from me beyond anger or failure.
author: Audre Lorde

quote: Everything want to be loved. Us sing and dance and holler, just trying to be loved.
author: Alice Walker

quote: I have waited for this opportunity for more than half a century, to repeat to you once again my vow of eternal fidelity and everlasting love.
author: Gabriel García Márquez
source: Love in the Time of Cholera

quote: Love is or it ain't. Thin love ain't love at all.
author: Toni Morrison

quote: So, I love you because the entire universe conspired to help me find you.
author: Paulo Coelho

quote: I cannot let you burn me up, nor can I resist you. No mere human can stand in a fire and not be consumed.
author: A. S. Byatt

quote: You said, 'I love you.' Why is it that the most unoriginal thing we can say to one another is still the thing we long to hear?
author: Jeanette Winterson

quote: I've never had a moment's doubt. I love you. I believe in you completely. You are my dearest one. My reason for life.
author: Ian McEwan

quote: I love you also means I love you more than anyone loves you, or has loved you, or will love you.
author: Jonathan Safran Foer

quote: For you, a thousand times over.
author: Khaled Hosseini

quote: This was love: a string of coincidences that gathered significance and became miracles.
author: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie

quote: I fell in love the way you fall asleep: slowly, and then all at once.
author: John Green

quote: I miss you more than I remember you.
author: Ocean Vuong

quote: I love you. I love you. I love you. I'll write it in waves. In skies. In my heart.
author: Amal El-Mohtar and Max Gladstone
source: This Is How You Lose the Time War
